ig_caption:
Wed, Nov 18: 11,113 deer reported statewide (7,517 antlered, 3,596 antlerless). Season total: 177,812.

Upper Peninsula counties grew fastest: Gogebic and Baraga each rose 20% in a day, and Ontonagon (60 new), Gogebic (49) and Alger (38) reported only antlered deer, while statewide the antlered share was 68% of 11,113 new reports.

Full county-by-county report: https://claude.ai/artifact/QSxie3gQQgNNuQDU3D7yTe
